notes.title: >Online Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to step into the magical 3D game world of 'Conquering the World'! After countless days and nights of careful design and polishing, this game will finally be officially launched on the Steam platform on November 30, 2024, and is now available to everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276947/9b34047c9dd0135fbd62d9471f9a291cf8909014.jpg[/img]

In 'Conquering the World', you will enter an adventure field full of unknowns and surprises. Faced with numerous levels and enemies, you need to use flexible operations and wisdom to defeat enemies, crack levels, and move forward bravely. And when you open the treasure chest, you will receive the assistance of powerful teammates, fight alongside them, overcome difficulties together, and experience the joy of teamwork.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276947/8aa0ef485998e8986c74431773be82df1cce066b.jpg[/img]

As an independently developed 3D game, it requires one person to balance the work of art, planning, and programming. During the development process, I encountered many problems and difficulties, and have thought about giving up many times. But in the end, they persisted in overcoming each one and persevered to complete this work. During the development process, countless efforts were put into it. However, due to personal limitations and time constraints, there may still be some shortcomings in the game. We hope everyone can forgive us and welcome valuable feedback.
Come and join our adventure team to explore this 3D world full of surprises and challenges!
Thank you all for your support and companionship. Your support is the driving force for me to move forward. Perhaps it is with your encouragement that I am able to continue developing independent games and bring more exciting works to everyone.
